gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 diagnoses an extra A factor and an inapplicable vector-space instantiation of the abstract lemma. It does not identify the distinct induction failure in which the direct term must be alpha_i rather than alpha_{i+1}, nor the resulting one-order index mismatch in the output-LTE application.

Both identify that the output recurrence/map incorrectly includes an A factor: the stage-error recursion has A, but the output recurrence requires the C^ell map without A. ISSUE-002 also gives the corrected operator, directly repairing the gold defect.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The output-LTE tree representation uses the stage-error map with an extra leading A, so it does not reproduce the stated psi/output formulas; the output-map instantiation must use (C^ell tensor I) while retaining A only in the separate stage-error map.

component_coverage.gold_component: The A factor is incorrectly included in the output recurrence/map even though it belongs only to the stage-error recursion.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-002 explicitly contrasts the proof's (AC^ell) map with the stated C^ell formula and attributes the discrepancy to the output recursion lacking A.

component_coverage.gold_component: The wrong output map prevents derivation of the stated output-LTE formulas and leaves the output part of the theorem unsupported.
